summary: The customer was looking for over-the-counter medications for motion sickness, specifically a non-drowsy option that they could take before a flight. The representative recommended Bonine or non-drowsy Dramamine, both available in chewable form, which usually take effect within 30 to 60 minutes. They also offered to hold a pack of the product at the front desk for the customer's arrival. The customer also asked for travel-size hand sanitizer, which the store offered at the register.
